list.item: When Raoul runs on the treadmill at the gym, the number of calories, \(c\), he burns varies directly with the number of minutes, \(m\), he uses the treadmill. He burned 315 calories when he used the treadmill for 18 minutes.

problem.para: How many calories would he burn if he ran on the treadmill for 25 minutes?

list.item: The number of calories, \(c\), burned varies directly with the amount of time, \(t\), spent exercising. Arnold burned 312 calories in 65 minutes exercising.

problem.para: How many calories would he burn if he exercises for 90 minutes?

list.item: The distance a moving body travels, \(d\), varies directly with time, \(t\), it moves. A train travels 100 miles in 2 hours.

problem.para: How many miles would it travel in 5 hours?
